description: Wait up to timeoutSeconds for one export to finish and return its status, without opening a new view. The view from exports_start already shows live progress, so use this tool, not exports_list, while waiting. nextAction is wait (call again), done (downloadUrl is ready unless clip QA holds it) or stop (failed or cancelled).

exportId.description: Export ID returned by exports_start. UUID string.

timeoutSeconds.description: Longest time to wait in this call. Returns earlier when the export finishes.

name: exports_wait
title: Wait for Export
